description: Buffer/event-relative compressed first-common-reset output DFAs for the #623 digit-pair carry transducers.

semantics.recovery: The output sink is absorbing. At the first transition into an output state, the current input symbol is exactly previous_pair. The pair+length variant retains witness_length; the second witness symbol is recovered from the rolling last-five history at index 6-L.
semantics.requirement: The consumer must retain the current input symbol at the first output event; for the pair+length interface, maintain the rolling last-five-symbol history.
